proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ M _
  constructor
  · intro hinj m hm y hy
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S m) := IsLocalization.map_units S (⟨m, hm⟩ : M)
    apply hinj
    rw [map_zero]
    have : algebraMap R S m * algebraMap R S y = 0 := by rw [← map_mul, hy, map_zero]
    exact hu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp this
  · intro h
    refine IsLocalization.injective S (M := M) fun m hm => mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mpr ?_
    intro y hy
    exact h m hm y (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hy)
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S], Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) ↔ ∀ m ∈ M, ∀ y : R, m * y = 0 → y = 0
